async function run(groups, read) {
 for (const batch of groups) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(batch.map(async item => { const row = await read(item); return await save(row); }));
 }

 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript

  await prepare(batch);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(batch.map(async item => await read(item)));
 }
